consulted_citations.field: 火 headword; PDF p. 900, printed p. 885; continuation PDF p. 901, printed p. 886
consulted_citations.text: I directly inspected the supplied scan pixels for PDF pp. 900–901. The 火 entry prints 合集 11503 as “有新大星并火,” glosses 晶 as 星, then says “可能指的是火星.” It names 火星 but does not specify 心宿二 or the planet Mars. The entry continues on printed p. 886 with graphic-history discussion and ends before 燹. The inspected wording agrees with the provisional OCR; no OCR correction is proposed.
